subject: DPA intake: onboarding questionnaire, subprocessor declaration & e-sign routing
messages:
From: Ella Ramos <ella@paytoninc.com>
To: camila_reyes@redwood.com
Cc: procure@paytoninc.com
Date: 2027-07-18 09:12 -0700
Subject: Initial DPA intake and subprocessor details request

Hi Camila,

Thanks for the demo last week. Procurement asked me to kick off the privacy paperwork so we can get legal review ahead of the PO. Can you send over your standard DPA template and the current subprocessor list? A couple items to call out from our side:

- We need to confirm cross-border transfer mechanisms (EU->US) and whether you rely on GCP/AWS data plane in the EU.
- Our security team will want a short attestation of encryption-in-transit and at-rest controls.
- Preference is DocuSign but if you only support AdobeSign, we can accept that — just let us know expected routing and who signs first.

I've attached a short intake form (Payton_DPA_Request_Form.pdf) that outlines our standard clauses and timing expectations. Can you confirm an estimated timeline for redlines and e-sign? We are aiming to complete legal sign-off within two weeks.

Thanks,
Ella Ramos
Contracts Manager
Payton Inc.

Attachment: Payton_DPA_Request_Form.pdf (pdf)
From: camila_reyes@redwood.com
To: Ella Ramos <ella@paytoninc.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, olga_petrov@redwood.com
Date: 2027-07-18 11:03 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial DPA intake and subprocessor details request

Hi Ella — great to hear from you and glad the demo helped.

Attached is our current DPA template (Redwood_DPA_Template_v1.0.docx). High level:
- We use a combination of EU SCCs (where requested) and standard SCC+Transfer Risk Assessment for EU transfers when customers need specific controls.
- Primary data plane is hosted on GCP in the EU for EU-region customers; hosted API customers may transit through multi-region infra depending on region routing.
- Encryption: TLS 1.2+ in transit; AES-256 at rest for persisted stores.

Quick ask from our side to speed review: can you confirm whether Payton requires the UK Addendum/SCCs or additional local transfer mechanisms? Also, please tell us if you have any absolute objections to our standard subprocessor clause (we typically list cloud infra, SSO provider, analytics).

Suggested next steps:
1) We’ll take a look at your intake form and call out any showstoppers by EOD tomorrow.
2) If you want, we can provide a redline and propose execution via DocuSign. Envelope routing would be Redwood -> Payton (Redwood signs first), unless Payton requests otherwise.

I’m looping in Ben (sales ops) and Olga (security) for any technical/attestation questions.

Thanks,
Camila Reyes
Senior Account Lead, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Redwood_DPA_Template_v1.0.docx (docx)
From: Ella Ramos <ella@paytoninc.com>
To: camila_reyes@redwood.com
Cc: Payton Procurement <procure@paytoninc.com>
Date: 2027-07-19 08:25 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial DPA intake and subprocessor details request

Thanks Camila — this is helpful. A few clarifications from our intake form:

- Payton requires the UK Addendum for UK entities; Payton's EU ops team says SCCs alone are insufficient.
- Can you confirm the list of subprocessors by name + country? Specifically: the analytics vendor and the logging/monitoring provider.
- Our procurement team prefers Redwood to sign last. They’ll countersign after legal review. Is that workable?

Procurement asked that I attach the intake PDF returned with internal notes. We also asked for a short turnaround on redlines (3 business days) if possible.

Ella

Attachment: Payton_DPA_Request_Form.pdf (annotated)
From: camila_reyes@redwood.com
To: Ella Ramos <ella@paytoninc.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, olga_petrov@redwood.com
Date: 2027-07-19 14:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial DPA intake and subprocessor details request

Ella — thanks, noted. We reviewed your intake and prepared a short redline and answers to the subprocessor questions. Summary:

- UK Addendum: Approved — we can attach the UK Addendum and support execution with UK Addendum + SCCs.
- Subprocessors (current):
  * GCP (Google Cloud) — eu-west-1 (Belgium) — infrastructure
  * Segment Analytics — us-east-1 (USA) — pseudonymous usage metrics
  * Datadog Monitoring — eu-west-1 (Ireland) — observability logs (access controls applied)

- Encryption attestation: Olga confirms TLS 1.2+ and AES-256 at rest; key management via customer KMS is available for Private deployments (we provided a short snippet below).

We attached a redlined version (Redwood_DPA_Template_v1.1-redlined.docx) with limited edits: clarification of transfer mechanics, explicit UK Addendum clause, and a small change to execution order to allow Payton to request Redwood sign second.

Regarding e-sign: we can do DocuSign and set routing order to Payton -> Redwood (if Payton prefers us to sign last). Please confirm the signing order and provide the primary signatory name and email at Payton so we can prepare the envelope.

DocuSign draft link (placeholder): https://docusign.com/envelope/INITIAL_LINK_PLACEHOLDER

If acceptable, Marissa (legal) will do the final sign-off from our side and we’ll route the DocuSign envelope once Payton confirms the signer.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Senior Account Lead, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Redwood_DPA_Template_v1.1-redlined.docx (docx)
From: Ella Ramos <ella@paytoninc.com>
To: camila_reyes@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: Payton Procurement <procure@paytoninc.com>
Date: 2027-07-21 14:45 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial DPA intake and subprocessor details request

Camila / Marissa — good to have everyone looped in. Procurement confirms Payton will sign first (Payton -> Redwood) and the primary signer is:

Name: Marcus Bell
Title: VP, Legal Ops
Email: marcus.bell@paytoninc.com

We accept your redlines except for one small ask around logging retention (Payton requests 90 days maximum for observability logs containing request metadata). Marissa — can you confirm whether Datadog retention can be scoped to 90 days for Payton-specific telemetry?

If Marissa confirms we can scope that retention, we are ready to receive the DocuSign envelope and will route for Marcus to sign. Please send the envelope with the routing order Payton -> Redwood. Once signed we’ll return a fully executed PDF.

Thanks,
Ella Ramos
Contracts Manager
Payton Inc.

Attachment: Signed_DPA_Payton.pdf (to follow after signing)
